● THE SCRIPT

User Stories

The Moviesstore project allows users to access a catalogue of movies and place an order. The catalogue of movies also contain description and reviews to help the user with their selection. The administrator can create, update, or delete movies, users, reviews, and orders. This project can be accessed by users through the link https://aasuresh310.pythonanywhere.com/ with any device as it contains responsive Graphical User Interface (GUI) so users can access it through different devices with diverse screen sizes.

user story 01

User Story 1

As a user, I want to see information about the GT Movies Store so I can learn more about the app and its purpose. The about page tells the user about the purpose of the app.

user story 02

User Story 2

As a user, I want to register an account so that I can access the GT Movies Store. The user can sign up for an account. If the password is too similar to the username or too short, or the passwords do not match when typed twice, the user is prompted to sign up again with the proper error messages.

user story 03

User Story 3

As a registered user, I want to log in so that I can access my account data. If the username or password is incorrect, an error message will be displayed and the user will be prompted to log in again.

user story 04

User Story 4

As a user, I want to be able to view the list of movies available in the GT Movies Store so I can make my selections. This page can be accessed by clicking "Movies" in the navigation bar.

user story 05

User Story 5

As a user, I want to search movies per title so I can make my selections. If the user only types even part of a title, all titles containing that part will be displayed. If the user types in a title that does not exist in the catalogue, the search result will be empty.

user story 06

User Story 6

As a user, I want to be able to access a shopping cart so I can list all movie items I am willing to purchase. The user can see the product ID, name of the movie, price of the movie, and the quantity of that product (movie) ordered. This page can be accessed by either clicking the "cart" button in the navigation bar, or adding a movie to cart.

user story 07

User Story 7

As a user, I want to be able to add one or more items of a movie to my shopping cart so I can purchase them in the future. The user can select the quantity by typing in a number into the "quantity" bar, or using the arrows. Then the user must click "Add to cart" which takes them to their cart page to see all movies they have added.

user story 08

User Story 8

As a user, I want to create movie reviews so others can use my insights when searching for movies. The user can add these reviews by clicking on a movie title, writing a review, and clicking "Add a Review". This review will be visible for all users. A review can only be added when the user was able to login.

user story 09

User Story 9

As a user, I want to be able to remove all movie items from my shopping cart so I can have flexibility on what I purchase or not. The "Remove all movies from cart" button in the cart page implements this functionality.

user story 10

User Story 10

As a user, I want to edit my reviews so I have the freedom to change my mind about my reviews. A user can only edit their own reviews, and can do so by clicking the "edit review" button.

user story 11

User Story 11

As a user, I want to delete my movie reviews so I have the freedom to change my mind about my reviews. A user can only delete their own reviews, and that specific review will then be deleted in all other users' page as well.

user story 12

User Story 12

As a user, I want to see the reviews of a movie so I can have information on whether I should purchase a movie or not. A user can see the reviews made by all other users and by themselves by simply clicking on the movie title (if a review exists).

user story 13

User Story 13

As a user, I want to see the details of a movie so I have the information to make my choices. This can be seen in under "description" when a movie title is clicked. The description is created by the admin.

user story 14

User Story 14

As a user, I want to see a list of my orders so I can track what I have purchased and my expenses. The user can go to the orders page by clicking the "Orders" button in the navigation bar, and can see all their previous orders. Each order is displayed as unique order id, date and time the order was placed, total price, and a table containing each item (movie) ID, movie name, movie price, and quantity.

user story 15

User Story 15

As a user, I want to be able to access the GT Movies Store from any desktop using a web browser, so I can use the app anywhere with an internet connection. Users can access this website through the pythonAnywhere link: https://aasuresh310.pythonanywhere.com/.

user story 16

User Story 16

As a user, I want the GT Movies Store to feature a responsive Graphical User Interface (GUI) so I can access it through different devices with diverse screen sizes.

user story 17

User Story 17

As an administrator, I want to be able to manage (view, create, update, or delete) users from the GT Movies Store so we can keep information up to date. This can only be done if the user has admin privileges (through createsuperuser in this instance). The admin can also see further information like the date and time the user joined the app.

user story 18

User Story 18

As an administrator, I want to be able to manage (view, create, update, or delete) movies from the GT Movies Store so we can keep information up to date. Admin can update the movie's name, price, description, and image as well.

user story 19

User Story 19

As an administrator, I want to be able to manage (create, update, or delete) reviews from the GT Movies Store so we can keep information up to date. The admin can also change the movie and user associated with the review as well as edit or delete the review.

user story 20

User Story 20

As an administrator, I want to be able to manage (create, update, or delete) orders from the GT Movies Store so we can keep information up to date. The administrator can also change the total price and user associated with a particular order.

user story 21

User Story 21

As a user, I want to report inappropriate reviews so that the comment section isn't cluttered with irrelevant/offensive reviews and the review is removed from the page moving forward. Any user can report an inappropriate review by clicking the "report" button under that review, which will delete that review for all users. Note that the "delete" button is only displayed if the user themselves wrote that review, but the "report" button is visible even if another user created that review.
